title: Comet Protocol for FFPE Slides - Benchmarking Project SenNet
author: Nicola Neretti
materials: Trim block until sample is exposed
Citrate buffer 1x working solution 7ml 10x Citrate buffer pH 6.0 (Abcam AB64214) Add 63 ml distilled water
Prepare the reagents according to the reagents protocol attached and run the Comet according to the manufactures guideline. Comet_reagent_preparation_skin.pdf Comet_reagent_preparation_lung.pdf

steps.title: Ice chill samples
steps.instruction: Place the samples on ice for a minimum of 20 minutes.

steps.title: Warm water bath
steps.instruction: Lay sections on a water bath set to 40–45 °C until wrinkles unfold.

steps.title: Mount sections on slides
steps.instruction: Pick up each section and place it onto a SuperFrost Plus slide.

steps.title: Air‑dry slides
steps.instruction: Allow the slides to air dry at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Oven‑dry slides
steps.instruction: Place the slides in an oven set to 60 °C and leave overnight.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and hydrate
steps.instruction: Run the slides through a series of solvents in Coplin jars as follows.

steps.title: Set up steamer
steps.instruction: Assemble the steaming compartment and start the steamer.

substeps.instruction: Fill the water basin with deionized water.
Place the plastic steaming compartment on top of the water basin.
Insert an empty Coplin jar into the steaming compartment.
Turn on the steamer until visible steam escapes the vent; keep the lid closed.

steps.title: Boil citrate buffer
steps.instruction: Heat approximately 75 ml of 1× sodium citrate buffer to boiling using a hot plate or microwave.

steps.title: Add slides to hot buffer
steps.instruction: Using heat‑resistant gloves, pour the boiling citrate buffer into the Coplin jar, add the slides, cover with aluminum foil, close the lid, and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Pour boiling buffer into the Coplin jar inside the steaming compartment.
Place the slides into the buffer‑filled jar.
Cover the jar with aluminum foil and close the lid.

steps.title: Cool slides in buffer
steps.instruction: Turn off the steamer, remove the lid, ensure the buffer still covers the tissue, and let slides cool in the buffer.

substeps.instruction: Turn off the steamer and remove the lid.
Confirm the citrate buffer remains covering the entire tissue.
Allow slides to cool at room temperature for 20–30 minutes, or place the jar on ice until the buffer is cold.

steps.title: Final washes
steps.instruction: Wash the sections sequentially in distilled water and PBS.
